from PyQt5 import QtWidgets,uic

def verif(x):
    if len(x) != 0 and x.isnumeric():
        return True
    else :
        return False
def convertir(a,b):
    ch=""
    while a != 0 :
        r = a % b
        a = a // b
        if r < 10 :    
            ch = str(r) + ch
        else :
            ch = chr(55+r) + ch
    return ch
def traitement(a):
    if verif(a):
        p.t2.setText(convertir(int(a),2))
        p.t3.setText(convertir(int(a),8))
        p.t4.setText(convertir(int(a),16))
    else:
        p.t2.setText("INPUT ERROR")
        p.t3.setText("INPUT ERROR")
        p.t4.setText("INPUT ERROR")
def effacer():
    p.t1.setText("")
    p.t2.setText("")
    p.t3.setText("")
    p.t4.setText("")
    p.t1.setFocus()

app = QtWidgets.QApplication([])
p = uic.loadUi("convertir_base.ui")
p.show()
p.pb1.clicked.connect(lambda:traitement(p.t1.text()))
p.pb2.clicked.connect(effacer)
app.exec_()
